infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: PS20 requires your location to pinpoint your emergency coordinates and dispatch rescue services accurately.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: PS20 requires camera access to attach real-time photo evidence of the disaster scenario to your emergency report.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: PS20 requires photo library access to upload disaster evidence.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow PS20 to use your location for emergency dispatch.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow PS20 to access camera for incident reporting.
